final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers cu ON cu.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY cu.gender), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS avg_orders_of_above_average_genders, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n
